definitions.explanation: The seventh month of the year. The rainy season ends and summer begins in earnest. Features Tanabata (July 7th).

examples.japanese: {七月|しちがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{七月|しちがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{七月|しちがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたく→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When July comes, I want to go to the beach.

examples.japanese: {七月|しちがつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。

examples.japanese: {七月|しちがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}いでいます→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I swim in the sea every year in July, and I'd like to go this year too.

notes:
{七月|しちがつ} is the seventh month of the year.

PRONUNCIATION:
- Standard: しちがつ
- Alternative: なながつ (to avoid confusion with いちがつ)

JAPANESE MONTHS:
All months use number + ⟦{月|がつ}→月：02230_tsuki⟧:
- ⟦{一月|いちがつ}→一月：00631_ichigatsu⟧ (January) through ⟦{十二月|じゅうにがつ}→十二月：00636_juunigatsu⟧ (December)

JULY EVENTS:
- ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧ (July 7): Star Festival celebrating the yearly meeting of Orihime and Hikoboshi
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (3rd Monday): Marine Day holiday
- ⟦{梅雨明|つゆあ}け→梅雨明け：08338_tsuyuake⟧: End of rainy season
- ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧: Summer vacation begins

SEASON:
July marks the beginning of true summer (⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧) after the rainy season ends.
